Boundaries.Name: fan-out
Boundaries.Contract: Keep public fan-out ownership through endpoint discovery, all target outcomes and cleanup. Public facet validation remains in its enclosing declared owner.

Boundaries.Name: fan-out-target
Boundaries.Contract: Each returned endpoint failure has an independent failure-only owner through capacity waits, conversion and pool cleanup. The parent returns the error result without publishing the node failure again.

Boundaries.Name: fan-out-target-borrowed-send
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the endpoint owner through capacity admission, physical send, conversion, ReleaseServerPoolAsync and semaphore release.

NonRoutes.Reason: Local value construction, validation, formatting, comparison or state inspection; no command dispatch.
